LOT-1234 processed after heater jump measured 498.63 A with range_A 6.83 in_spec true in_control true

disposition.summary: Heater sensor reports ~14C rise starting at LOT-1234 after PM, but two wafers deposited after the rise (LOT-1234 498.63A, LOT-1239 498.95A) remain in-control and slightly thinner than the pre-PM mean, opposite to expected thicker film from real heater increase. This indicates sensor misreport, not real temperature change. Release lot and flag DEP02-B heater_temp_C sensor.
